title: Toobit Appoints Yasser Elmansy as Chief Growth Officer
summary: The popular cryptocurrency exchange Toobit announced the appointment of Yasser Elmansy as Chief Growth Officer. In this role, he will lead the company’s global growth strategy, focusing on international expansion, strategic partnerships, and business development.
